title: Ilizwi Lokuqina
intro: Lo mntu ukhunjulwa ngobulumko obunzulu kunye nesikhokelo, enika icebiso elingaphaya kwezizukulwana. Amazwi abo angqina ukuzinikela kunye nokubaluleka kokuqaphela iintsikelelo kunye nezilingo ezivela kuThixo. Tyhila ubuwena balo mphefumlo uhlonitshwayo.
clues: Bendingengomprofeti, kodwa ubulumko bam abunakufa kwiZibhalo eziNgcwele.
Icebiso lam kumntwana wam ligxininise ekubuleleni uAllah nasekuphepheni i-shirk.
Ndifundise ngokubaluleka komthandazo, ukuyalela okulungileyo, nokuthintela ububi.
Igama lam linikwe isahluko esipheleleyo kwiQuran, sigxininisa iimfundiso zam.
Icebiso lam laliquka umonde xa kunzima, kuba ngokwenene, oko kuvela kwezona zinto zibalulekileyo.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
